label: The bunker safety checklist with five checks that tick off one by one - the procedure and emergency plan agreed in writing, communications and the ship-shore link, gas and fire detection, remote-controlled valves, hoses and couplings - signed by the person in charge on the ship and the person in charge on the bunkering source, who keep in constant contact; if contact is lost or a condition is not met, the stop button is pressed and the transfer stops.

steps: Procedure and emergency plan agreed in writing

steps.title: 1 · The persons in charge agree in writing the transfer procedure and what to do in an emergency
2 · They check and sign the bunker safety checklist together
3 · Each check on the list is ticked in turn - then both persons in charge sign
4 · During the transfer the two persons in charge keep in constant contact
5 · Contact lost or a condition not met - stop the transfer
